semantic_controls: grain statement is a programme control, not a claim about mandatory SQL syntax
CTE materialization behaviour is pinned to PostgreSQL 17 and not generalized to every DBMS
recursive evaluation order is not confused with SEARCH output ordering
unsafe recursion is tested only under statement_timeout in an isolated transaction
ranking functions state tie semantics and deterministic tie breakers
lag on sparse periods is not called previous calendar period until a calendar scaffold is joined
default frame and ROWS/RANGE peer behaviour are made explicit
coursera: not used; deferred to module construction by owner policy
